q: Are you going to sell to me on the call?
a: It's a discovery call: we map your operation and tell you what we see. At the end, if it makes sense, we share an implementation proposal. If it doesn't, we tell you that too. There's no sales presentation dressed up as a diagnosis and no obligation to buy: you decide whether to move forward.
short: No. It's a discovery call: we map your operation and tell you what we see.

q: What should I prepare for the call?
a: Nothing special. Knowing how your business runs day to day is enough. If you have numbers on hand, even better: the diagnosis gets more precise. For example, how many messages or leads you get per week, how long it takes you to reply, and which tools your team uses to sell and follow up.
short: Nothing special; if you have numbers from your operation on hand, the diagnosis is more precise.

q: What if my business is too small or too big?
a: We work with small and midsize businesses of 3 to 40 employees in any industry. If you're outside that range, the call makes it clear in the first few minutes and we point you to the right option. What matters most isn't size, but whether the business depends on you to run and you want to systematize it.
short: We work with small and midsize businesses of 3 to 40 employees; if you're outside that range, we point you in the right direction.
